question: Which of the following is the principal strategy adopted by National Literacy Mission for the eradication of illiteracy?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Total Literacy Campaign**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **National Literacy Mission (NLM)** was launched by the Government of India in **1988** with the aim of eradicating **illiteracy** in the country.
 
• The **Total Literacy Campaign (TLC)** is the principal strategy adopted under the National Literacy Mission to achieve this goal.
 
• The focus of the campaign is on imparting **functional literacy** to **non-literate adults** aged **15-35 years**.
